info.name: WorldCat Entity Data Bibliographic Resources Member Shared Print Holdings API
Find member shared print holdings for a known item

params.name: oclcNumber
params.description: oclc number of the bibliographic item

params.name: isbn
params.description: isbn of the bibliographic item (bn index)

params.name: issn
params.description: issn of the bibliographic item (in index)

params.name: heldByGroup
params.description: Restrict to holdings held by Group Symbol

params.name: heldInState
params.description: Restrict to holdings held by Institutions in requested State/Province, per ISO 3166-2.

params.name: itemType
params.description: Limiter to restrict the response to the single specified OCLC top-level facet type (x0 index). (book, image)

params.name: itemSubType
params.description: Limiter to restrict the response to the single specified OCLC sub facet type (x1 index). (dvd, digital)

params.name: offset
params.description: start position of the bib records to return (0 based), default 0

params.name: limit
params.description: maximum number of records to return, maximum 50, default 10

items.docs: Given a known item, find the member library holdings with a commitment to retain (Shared Print)
